title: Bogan on Sunday
style: Australian pub-rock with swaggering mid-tempo stomp, syncopated bass and handclap groove; verse rides dry guitar and loose snare, pre-chorus strips to bass and stomped floor-tom, chorus hits with gang chants and a wiry lead riff. Grizzled male vocals with shouted doubles on hook lines, cheeky ad-libs tucked wide. Uplifts with beer-bottle taps, a short whistle pickup, and a final chorus lift; bright, punchy, bar-room mix.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Pulled up in me ute, mate
Dust on the tray, sun baked
Said, "How ya goin'?"
I said, "Yeah, sweet as"

Old billie on the esky
Snack tin full of shapes
Skippin' work for a knock-off
Just another arvo break

[Pre-Chorus]
She said, "You crook?"
I said, "Nah, just rooted"
Laughin' at me thongs
And me shirt all spewed on

[Chorus]
Sweet as, sweet as
We’re ridin' it out, mate
Sweet as, sweet as
No worries, no stress, eh
Hit me with a yarn
And I’ll back you, true blue
Sweet as, sweet as
That’s how we do

[Verse 2]
At the servo, I’m skint
Two bucks and a packet of chips
Mum rang up, said, "You keen?"
I said, "Yeah, I’m keen as"

Footy on the telly
Mates all packed in the shed
Someone yelled, "She’ll be right"
As the whole place bled red

[Pre-Chorus]
If it all goes sideways
We’ll have a laugh first
Grab a cold one, settle
Let the hard luck burst

[Chorus]
Sweet as, sweet as
We’re ridin' it out, mate
Sweet as, sweet as
No worries, no stress, eh
Hit me with a yarn
And I’ll back you, true blue
Sweet as, sweet as
That’s how we do

[Bridge]
Rough day? Bloody oath
Good day? Bloody oath
Bit lost? Be a legend
Take the long way home

[Final Chorus]
Sweet as, sweet as
We’re ridin' it out, mate
Sweet as, sweet as
No worries, no stress, eh
Hit me with a yarn
And I’ll back you, true blue
Sweet as, sweet as
That’s how we do
Sweet as, sweet as
Yeah, that’s how we do
